title: Altius Labs strategic investment in edgeX expands cross-asset trading infrastructure
digest:
Altius Labs has invested in edgeX and announced a collaboration to build a full-asset trading infrastructure, with current progress including expanding services to tokenized stocks, commodities, and forex, and developing a CLOB-RFQ hybrid trading engine to enhance execution efficiency.

edgeX, launched in October 2024, claims to have served 500,000 users and accumulated over $110 billion in transactions as of the latest report.

The partnership aims to integrate edgeX's trading platform and liquidity with Altius Labs' infrastructure stack, targeting global exchanges and brokers with combined matching, clearing, and settlement services.

representative.title: Altius Labs 入股 edgeX 共建全资产交易基础设施
representative.summary: Altius Labs 入股 edgeX 并共建全资产交易基础设施。edgeX 自2024年10月上线以来已服务50万用户，累计交易量超1.1万亿美元。双方将整合edgeX的交易平台与流动性，以及Altius Labs的基础设施栈，面向全球交易所、券商等提供撮合、清算和结算服务。产品将扩展至代币化股票、大宗商品和外汇，开发CLOB与RFQ混合交易引擎以提升执行效率。

timeline.title: Founders Fund支持的Altius Labs投资edgeX以构建全球交易与流动性网络
timeline.summary: Founders Fund支持的Altius Labs宣布投资edgeX，共同开发全球交易与流动性网络。双方将整合edgeX的现有交易运营与流动性基础设施，并开发混合交易引擎（中央限价订单簿+询价机制），计划拓展加密货币、代币化股票、大宗商品和外汇等资产类别。edgeX自2024年10月上线后已吸引超50万用户，累计交易额超11万亿美元。
